description: Comprehensive document filing system with drag-and-drop upload, automatic parsing of work instructions to extract part numbers and tools, integration with assembly workflow, and version control. Non-work-instruction documents are stored in a document repository.

userStories.title: Add workInstruction table to database schema
userStories.description: Create the core work instruction table for storing parsed work instructions
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'workInstruction' table: id (text PK), documentNumber (text unique, e.g., WIMF-SPU-001), title (text), description (text), documentType (text: 'spu_assembly' | 'general'), status (text: 'draft' | 'active' | 'archived'), currentVersion (integer default 1), originalFileName (text), fileSize (integer), mimeType (text), createdAt, updatedAt, createdBy (FK to user)

userStories.title: Add workInstructionVersion table for version history
userStories.description: Track all versions of work instructions with full content
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'workInstructionVersion' table: id (text PK), workInstructionId (FK), version (integer), content (text - full parsed text), rawContent (text - original file content as base64), changeNotes (text), parsedAt (timestamp), parsedBy (FK to user), createdAt

userStories.title: Add workInstructionStep table for individual steps
userStories.description: Store each step from a work instruction with sequence and content
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'workInstructionStep' table: id (text PK), workInstructionVersionId (FK), stepNumber (integer), title (text), content (text), requiresScan (boolean default false), scanPrompt (text - what to scan), notes (text), createdAt

userStories.title: Add stepPartRequirement table for parts per step
userStories.description: Link parts (PT#) to specific work instruction steps
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'stepPartRequirement' table: id (text PK), stepId (FK to workInstructionStep), partNumber (text - the PT# from document), partDefinitionId (FK to partDefinition, nullable), quantity (integer default 1), notes (text), createdAt

userStories.title: Add stepToolRequirement table for tools per step
userStories.description: Link tools (Tool#) to specific work instruction steps
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'stepToolRequirement' table: id (text PK), stepId (FK to workInstructionStep), toolNumber (text - the Tool# from document), toolName (text), calibrationRequired (boolean default false), notes (text), createdAt

userStories.title: Add documentRepository table for general documents
userStories.description: Store non-work-instruction documents in a general repository
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'documentRepository' table: id (text PK), fileName (text), originalFileName (text), fileSize (integer), mimeType (text), category (text nullable), tags (jsonb), content (text - base64 encoded), description (text), uploadedAt, uploadedBy (FK to user)

userStories.title: Add assemblyStepRecord table for tracking step completion
userStories.description: Record completion of each step during assembly with scanned lot numbers
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'assemblyStepRecord' table: id (text PK), assemblySessionId (FK), workInstructionStepId (FK), scannedLotNumber (text nullable), scannedPartNumber (text nullable), completedAt (timestamp), completedBy (FK to user), signatureId (FK to electronicSignature nullable), notes (text)

userStories.title: Add document and workInstruction permissions to RBAC
userStories.description: Add permission resources for document and work instruction management

userStories.title: Create document text extraction service
userStories.description: Service to extract text content from PDF and DOCX files
acceptanceCriteria: Install pdf-parse and mammoth packages for PDF/DOCX extraction
Implement extractText(buffer, mimeType): Promise<string> that routes to correct extractor
Handle errors gracefully with meaningful messages

userStories.title: Create work instruction parser service
userStories.description: Parse work instruction text to extract steps, PT#s, and Tool#s
acceptanceCriteria: Extract steps using regex patterns (Step 1:, 1., 1), etc.)
Extract PT# patterns (PT-001, PT#001, Part #001, etc.)
Extract Tool# patterns (Tool-001, Tool #1, T-001, etc.)
Return structured data: { steps: Step[], partsFound: string[], toolsFound: string[] }

userStories.description: Determine if uploaded document is SPU work instruction or general document
